scenario: A four-term comparison chain `r.a < r.b < r.c < r.d` compiles: no grammar or engine cap applies to chain length (LEXP.2.4.1). PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES: the lowering is not read, and no expansion is evaluated.
rules_ds:
schema Range scope logical:
    a: Int key
    b: Int mutable
    c: Int mutable
    d: Int mutable

rule ascending:
    Range r where r.a < r.b < r.c < r.d
->
    log info "ascending"
